name: The Gallery
description: A cluster of wagons and caravans at the edge of Spectacle Summit where artisans trade and sell.

description_citations.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
description_citations.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: At the gallery, Rootha meets Lux and Justice, who learn she is a Champion who helped drive off the Phyrexians; she flees.
timeline.quote: She was one of the five students who performed the invocation to drive the Phyrexians from campus.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha bumps into Kahri and Dean Nassari appears, but does not look at Rootha.
timeline.quote: Nassari stands right there and doesn't look at me once.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The rogue elemental whale appears and floods the gallery with water.
timeline.quote: An enormous cerulean whale, turned black in the dying evening light, swollen with magic and careening out of control across the summit.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha recognizes Glass inside the whale; Nassari concludes he has lost control.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Nassari's flames cut off the whale's limbs, but they grow back, and the boiling water endangers the crowd.
timeline.quote: a jet of flame escapes Nassari's palm

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha summons the Living Flame to lend Nassari more force, and takes Nassari's offered hand.
timeline.quote: I take Dean Nassari's hand, and the world around us turns to fire.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Their combined flames destroy the elemental whale in the Night of Flame, and nobody is seriously hurt.
timeline.quote: Shockingly, beyond a few burns and scrapes, no one was hurt that night.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Nassari apologizes for neglecting Rootha and what they said in the Biblioplex, and offers to be her advisor.
timeline.quote: You aren't looking for an advisor still, are you?

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Rootha helps Nassari to their feet, accepting the reconciliation.
timeline.quote: This time, I reach out a hand and pull them to theirs.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | A Living Flame" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2026.
